# Lichess piece sets

The unmodified SVGs in this directory come from the Lichess Lila repository at
revision `0e6b748940bdaa3e972613aaa15e29cfd22aa48c`.

- **Cburnett** by Colin M.L. Burnett, GNU General Public License version 2 or later. [Original SVGs](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/0e6b748940bdaa3e972613aaa15e29cfd22aa48c/public/piece/cburnett)
- **Merida** by Armando Hernandez Marroquin, GNU General Public License version 2 or later. [Original SVGs](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/tree/0e6b748940bdaa3e972613aaa15e29cfd22aa48c/public/piece/merida)

The SVGs are both the files rendered by the game and their editable source.
The two sets are listed under the free exceptions in the upstream copying
notice. [Lila copying notice at the bundled revision](https://github.com/lichess-org/lila/blob/0e6b748940bdaa3e972613aaa15e29cfd22aa48c/COPYING.md)
